citation.authors: Hiratsu A, Tataka Y, Namura S, Nagayama C, Hamada Y, Miyashita M
citation.title: The effects of acute and chronic oral l-arginine supplementation on exercise-induced ammonia accumulation and exercise performance in healthy young men: A randomised, double-blind, cross-over, placebo-controlled trial
citation.journal: Journal of Exercise Science and Fitness

population.description: Sixteen healthy young men (non-smokers, not overweight or obese, no supplements or medication); body mass 69.6 +/- 8.5 kg, VO2max 53.3 +/- 11.0 ml/kg/min.

protocols.name: acute_placebo_pre_exercise
protocols.description: Acute placebo trial, only the part before the exercise: 10-h overnight fast, fasting venous sample at 0900 h (minute 0 = paper's -60 min), then 200 mL water with 5.5 g dextrin (placebo) taken as 5.5 g carbohydrate (dextrin counted as digestible carbohydrate), 60 min seated rest, sample at the paper's 0 min (arm minute 60). The 60-min cycling at 75% of HR reserve and everything after it is not written (intensity not printed).

findings.description: Plasma glucose before the bout, acute placebo trial: fasting sample (paper -60 min = arm minute 0) and sample 60 min after the dextrin drink (paper 0 min = arm minute 60)

location.where: Table 2, rows Glucose, Placebo, Acute, columns -60 min and 0 min

findings.description: Serum NEFA before the bout, acute placebo trial: fasting sample (arm minute 0) and 60 min after the dextrin drink (arm minute 60)

location.where: Table 2, rows NEFA, Placebo, Acute, columns -60 min and 0 min

left_out.what: Glucose and NEFA at 60, 105 and 165 min (during/after the 60-min cycling at 75% of heart-rate reserve and the 15-min test) and their whole-period time averages, Table 2; mean HR 159 +/- 10 bpm during the bout
Serum triglycerides at all times, Table 2
Plasma ammonia and serum creatine kinase (Fig. 3, figure only)
Chronic placebo trial (day 15, after 13 days of dextrin twice a day) and both arginine trials, Tables 1-2
Mean power output of the 15-min performance test (158.4 +/- 37.7 W, acute placebo), after the 60-min bout whose intensity is not printed
